Chameleon Ultra USB ADC capture of a T5577 at PSK1 RF/32, 125 ksample/s.
Raw ID: 4944544BBFBBFD07. Generated test identity; not an access credential.
4000 unsigned bytes exported by LF sniff (negative ADC values clamped to zero,
then shifted right by 5 and capped at 255). Recorded on 2026-11-23 with the
tag touching the antenna, after a stress run found a weak-phase misdecode.

After skipping 1024 startup samples, the next 2048 contain one frame period.
The regression replays that period four times at all 32 sample offsets, without joining
the truncated period at the end of the 4000-sample capture. The first-matching-phase
decoder can repeat the same wrong payload; selecting agreement between
strong phases must always preserve all eight bytes of the expected ID.
